Third-pass correction for the Onslaught source reconstruction mobile controls. Your second proposal correctly rejected the production mobile-controls.js adapter, but its main.js patch has a bad hunk that leaves the original start-game line and adds a second start-game line, risking duplicate startWave calls. It also exposes a large new touch API that is probably unnecessary. Re-evaluate for an even smaller solution. Strong preference: DO NOT modify main.js if the existing public window.game.state and renderer plus the existing global key/mouse handlers are enough. A reconstruction-specific mobile-source-bridge.js may synthesize KeyboardEvent keydown/keyup for movement/reload/slide/weapon switching, synthesize mouse down/up on the renderer for fire/ADS, and directly adjust the already-public game.state.yaw/pitch for touch look. On coarse/touch devices, prevent control gestures from producing compatibility mouse/click leakage and neutralize pointer-lock requests only if needed; desktop behavior must remain untouched. Add bounded initialization, input cleanup on blur/pagehide, no hidden infinite loops, viewport/overscroll/safe-area protection, and a source-specific smoke test. Required controls: move, look, fire, ADS, reload, slide, weapon switching. The reconstruction currently has no jump physics, so do not invent a fake jump. Do not add pause/resume unless it can be done correctly without changing main.js. Do not patch the read-only production mobile assets. Verify every diff hunk is syntactically coherent and does not duplicate existing statements. Return the smallest justified unified diff plus exact tests GPT-5.6 Sol should run; do not claim tests were run.
